_doc: The Altstadt's secrets (T-0067, T-0070; docs/design/discoveries.md). from/to: "HH:MM" window it can be uncovered in (to before from wraps past midnight; equal = all day). level: the place's floor. clue_required: false lets a search at the place find the clue. share_trust: trust needed to share the clue in a conversation, -1 = never shared. known_at_start: a place whose residents or staff know the clue in a new town. effects: note {text}, money {cents} (once per world), moodlet {moodlet}, contact {place_id}: you get to know its residents or staff, unlock_interaction {interaction}: one whose requires_discovery is this, clue {discovery}: a lead to another secret. scene: optional, shown to the player on finding it. Content rules (AGENTS.md) apply to every line.

discoveries.name: Coins in the fountain
discoveries.clue: People toss coins into the Altmarkt fountain. Late at night nobody's watching.

effects.text: You fished €3.40 out of the fountain. Nobody saw.

discoveries.name: The note in the timetable case
discoveries.clue: Somebody keeps pinning things between the timetables at the tram stop. Have a proper look.

effects.text: Between the timetables: "Room in Haus 9, cash only, ask upstairs in the evening."

discoveries.name: The sublet in Haus 9
discoveries.clue: Someone in Haus 9 lets a room off the books. You'd meet them on the stairs in the evening.

effects.text: The people on the 2nd floor of Haus 9 sublet a room, off the lease. They keep to themselves.

discoveries.name: The door behind the bar
discoveries.clue: The bartenders at the Anker go down to the cellar more often than the beer needs.

effects.text: Behind the bar there's a padlocked cellar door. The light is on late at night.

discoveries.name: Kaya's workbench
discoveries.clue: The Späti people fix things for the neighbours, somewhere out the back in the Hinterhof.

effects.text: Under a tarp in the Hinterhof: a workbench, tools, half-fixed radios and a bike frame.

discoveries.name: The Waschsalon's back room
discoveries.clue: They say the back room of the Waschsalon has a door to the yard that doesn't quite lock. Best seen just before closing.

effects.text: The back door of the Waschsalon sticks, and it doesn't quite lock.

discoveries.name: The vestry
discoveries.clue: The service board at St. Nikolai mentions a vestry. In the daytime nobody minds if you sit there.

effects.text: A small room off the nave: an old chair, a warm radiator, nobody asks questions.

discoveries.name: The alcove under the bridge
discoveries.clue: Under the bridge steps on the Uferweg there's a dry corner, out of the wind. At night it's yours.

effects.text: A dry alcove under the bridge steps. If you ever need a place to sleep, it's here.
